claim_en: THE VOW CLASS. Gentiles vow; the class widened by 'all'; the nazirite out; no public compulsion; beasts whole and male, birds by a lesser bar.
THE FIVE-COUNT. Consecrate, slaughter, throw, burn, part, receive; individual not public; the class sweep; fell and broke exempt; the blood-rush arms.

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 7 11-13 + Chapter 7 1-4 + Onkelos Lev 22:22
claim_en: THE BEAST'S ROW. Tail not rib; charutz; the two-way transfer; slaughter banned; worked-with permitted; fats, part, blood, and the dispatched goat.
SARUA AND KALUT. Uncloven hoof; for upkeep not the altar; no whole animal for upkeep; Onkelos's extra-and-lacking fork.
THE CASTRATION BAN. Three anatomies; receive-blood sixth; birds, abroad, humans by revocalization; no shekels from gentiles; females disputed.
THE BIRTH LIST. Hybrid, look-alike, Caesarean, under-age, orphan; the tithe transfer; one hour with the mother; the eighth-day join.

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 8 8-12 + Chapter 8 1-4 + Onkelos Lev 22:28
claim_en: IT AND ITS YOUNG. Not wild, not bird; the female alone — Onkelos feminizing the verse; it and its mother; the order cases at forty and eighty.
THE FOUR PERIODS. The slaughter carve; the seller informs; the compelled butcher and the buyer's loss; day-after-night by the creation analogy.
THE REASSIGNMENT. The eating clause re-typed onto the slaughter; all one-day offerings.
KEEP AND DO. Mishnah and deed; hand yourself over among the many; no conditional miracles; the Exodus on condition.

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 7 1-5, 7 8-9, 7 11-13, Chapter 7 1, 7 4, 7 6, 7 9-12, Section 8 3-5, Chapter 8 1, 8 3-4, 8 8-9, Chapter 9 1-2, 9 4, 9 6; Mishnah Bekhorot 6:1, 6:3, 6:7, 6:12; Zevachim 8:1, 8:5, 8:8, 9:3; Temurah 6:1; Chullin 5:1-5; Shekalim 1:5; Onkelos Lev 22:22, 22:23, 22:28
claim_en: THE ACCEPTABLE ANIMAL ON ITS HAPAX AND ITS ONLY SEAT. The acceptance root at seven seats; the rite by call into the offering engine; one verb with three jobs by position; the four tokens of 22:22 assigned; Bekhorot 6 whole on the Sifra's members with three tokens shared with the priest's list; the corruption class in any amount; 'and from the day' a Tanakh hapax joined to the firstling (OWED to E1); 'on one day' the Torah's only seat, ben Zoma's day; the female by Onkelos's grammar; the second slaughter flogged. Filed F-229, auto-seated (sitting L5).
